Complete19-page main article98,705characters, all6mainfigures and both pages of Table1/all6patient columns read. Both supplements complete:9pages FiguresS1–S8 and4pages DataS1, text and pixels. No raw unpublished sequencing, raw electrophysiology traces, mouse single-cell datasets or STOmics dataset independently reanalyzed.

Six selected DEE cases, each with distinct de novo missense variant. Five of six cluster around phosphorylation sites; Glu189Val lies in I-BAR domain. General statements that all variants cluster in the phosphorylation region omit this exception. Figure1A shows five trios, excluding Individual5 whose de novo status is text-reported.

Important packet issues: Individual2 severe-ID exclusion contradicts S1B severeID; Individual5 severe-ID exclusion unsupported by moderate-to-severe range. Walking-delay negatives inP1/3/6 derive from16/19/18month milestones, not direct negative assessment. Many behavioral/MRI-specific negatives merely absent from narrative; broad No or normalMRI retained as qualified, time-bounded evidence.

Source clinical inconsistencies: P1seizure onset10months Table1 versus1y2m S1A. P3 seizure-free with VPA Table1/S1 but main3.2 says drop attacks after starting VPA. Table1 P2/P3 background abnormalities None versus S1 slowing at follow-up; do not merge these into a single definitive history. Paper says all remain alive and has no survival efficacy claim.

Mechanism: all6mutants increase HeLa circularity/mixed protrusions; rat electrophysiology tests4(E189V,T340K,T340A,R363H), notT340I/P342A. mIPSC negative tested ONLY R363H,n8, so discussion generalization to unaffected inhibition for all variants overreaches. Non-significant passive/AP measurements do not demonstrate every ion-channel function is normal.

14-3-3 affinity/autoinhibition inferred from docking, not direct binding or phosphorylation assay. E189V dimer MD predicts more-negative bindingenergy (-491vs-470kJ/mol) but does not directly measure lipid/actin binding. Main calls Lys340 hydrophobic; lysine is charged. These modeling descriptions are not biochemical demonstration.

Zebrafish injection globally overexpresses150pg humanmRNA, not endogenous heterozygous knock-in. S6B E189V mRNA~3.8xWT at72hpf,p=.0023, so that mutant is not expression-matched.
